visual.general_description: Three stacked rows of a patient follow-up chart: a dual-axis line chart of platelet count and anti-TPO antibodies, a treatment bar row, and a disease-course bar with a time arrow.
visual.detailed_description: A white figure with a bold rotated row title at the left of each of three horizontal bands. Top band, titled Platelet count and Anti-TPO antibodies: a line chart with a left axis labelled Platelet count x10³/µL with printed ticks 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 and 350, a right axis labelled Anti-TPO Antibodies (IU/mL) with printed ticks 0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000 and 9000, and a legend with a blue dot for Platelet count and a red dot for Anti-TPO antibodies. The blue platelet line is drawn as a double-stroked line with a few very early closely spaced fluctuations at the far left, then a sharp rise to a first peak and a fall, a long period of moderate undulation, a dip, a rise to a higher second peak with a small vertical step, a gradual fall and a small final rise; the line has no printed data labels. The red anti-TPO line begins only in the later part of the chart, rises briefly, falls steeply, then continues nearly flat with a slight rise at the far right; it has no printed data labels. No x-axis tick labels are printed under this chart. Middle band, titled Treatment: blue bars at the left, a narrow bar, a second short bar joined to a long bar, with leader arrows labelled Prednisone 2mg/kg body weight/day (pointing to the narrow bar and to the short bar), IVIG 1g/kg body weight (pointing to the short bar) and Prednisone 0.5mg/kg body weight/day (pointing to the long blue bar); two green bars to the right, a longer one joined to a shorter one with a dividing line, with arrows labelled Baricitinib 4mg/day (to the longer bar) and Baricitinib 2mg/day (to the shorter bar). Bottom band, titled Disease course: one long light-grey bar with five narrow coloured markers (red, red, green, red, green) whose arrows are labelled, in order from the left, First diagnosis of thrombocytopenia, Diagnosis of AA, AA partial response, AA worsening and AA complete response. Beneath it a black time arrow carries the tick labels 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, 3 years and 4 years. No patient name, date, institution or panel letter is printed.
